item.title: TTT 49: Pancakes
item.description:
Just because we have fancy equipment doesn’t mean actually know how to use it and make it sound like the price we paid for it. Give us a few episodes to work it out and we’ll sound like gold. If you listen carefully, you can actually hear Eric fix his own mic halfway through the show. Episode Links:

  • Chuck E. Cheese Fight
